ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious SignIns From A Non Registered Device
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects risky authentication from a non AD registered device without MFA being required. Note: Unmapped fields: Status, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskState, DeviceDetail.trusttype

sequences.query: (Status = "Success" AND AuthenticationRequirement = "singleFactorAuthentication" AND RiskState = "atRisk") AND (DeviceDetail.trusttype = "" OR DeviceDetail.trusttype = "None")
